 --> 5 International Movies and Shows Releasing on OTT This Week
 The third week of November brings a fresh line-up of Hollywood films and international series across Netflix, Prime Video, JioHotstar and other streaming platforms. From Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey to Percy Jackson Season 3, here are the titles to add to your watchlist. 
 Gayatri Rani 
 November 18, 2026 / 17:09 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 New international titles releasing this week 
 The third week of November brings an exciting line-up of new Hollywood OTT releases, with a mix of films and series across streaming platforms.  
 From Christopher Nolan’s epic adaptation of Homer’s The Odyssey and Nicolas Cage’s biographical sports drama MADDEN to fantasy adventures, animated comedies and international crime thrillers, there is plenty to add to the watchlist. 
 Here is a look at the international movies and TV shows arriving on OTT platforms this week and where you can watch them. 
 The Odyssey 
 Christopher Nolan’s directorial epic action adaptation of Homer's ancient Greek poem follows Odysseus, portrayed by Matt Damon, as he survives a punishing ten-year journey home after Troy's brutal fall. As he confronts mythical dangers across perilous seas, his wife Penelope, played by Anne Hathaway, must hold off dozens of aggressive suitors headed by Robert Pattinson's Antinous.  
 Filmed entirely with IMAX 70mm cameras, the film features an ensemble cast including Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway, Tom Holland, Zendaya, Robert Pattinson and others. 
 The Odyssey will be available to buy & rent on Apple TV, BookMyShow Stream, and Prime Video from November 18. 
 Percy Jackson & the Olympians Season 3 
 Drawing inspiration from Rick Riordan's The Titan's Curse, the third season follows Percy Jackson (Walker Scobell) as he sets out on a perilous mission to rescue Annabeth Chase (Leah Sava Jeffries) and free the goddess Artemis from her imprisonment. As Kronos threatens to topple Olympus, Percy and his allies must race against time to stop an approaching catastrophe. 
 Percy Jackson & the Olympians Season 3 will start streaming on November 20 on JioHotstar. 
 Steps 
 What unfolds when Cinderella's fairytale takes an unforeseen twist? This offbeat animated fantasy comedy puts a new spin on the classic tale, centring on Lilith (Ali Wong), one of Cinderella's stepsisters, who inadvertently plunges the kingdom into chaos after stealing the Fairy Godmother's (Bette Midler) wand. 
 Steps will start streaming on Netflix on November 20. 
 Perfect Liars 
 Jude Derry (Irene Balmes) enrols at the esteemed Tagus University on a covert mission to get closer to the affluent Cash brothers and uncover the truth behind her brother's premature death. Yet, as she immerses herself further in their world of privilege, her pursuit of vengeance becomes a perilous game of manipulation, seduction and betrayal. 
 Perfect Liars will be available to stream on Amazon Prime Video on November 20. 
 Also Read: Panchayat Season 5 OTT Release Date: When and where to watch Jitendra Kumar, Neena Gupta's rural comedy this year 
 The Blue Road 
 This cross-border crime thriller is a series co-produced by South Korea and Japan. Based on a 2002 manhwa, the story centers on a joint investigation set off by a series of strange international murders. After a victim is found in Tokyo with Korean letters written in blood, and another turns up in South Korea with Japanese text beside it, two detectives have to overcome the divide between their jurisdictions. Son Suk-ku plays the Korean investigator, working alongside Eita Nagayama as his Japanese counterpart to hunt down the serial killer. 
 The Blue Road will stream on Netflix from November 20. 
 Gayatri Rani is a Senior-Sub Editor with over three years of experience in delivering Hollywood and Bollywood news.
